newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end up on late blue chip buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end up on late blue chip buying.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended higher on Wednesday following modest late buying in selected blue-chips, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index ended 3.27 points, or 0.47 percent, higher at 693.04 points. Decliners led advancers by 86 to 46 with 73 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 494 billion rupiah against around 298 billion rupiah on Tuesday.
"Reports of expected strong earnings coupled with the old Telkom-SingTel rumours helped boost sentiment," one broker said.
